claims.claim: CopyImageSubData does not perform general-purpose format conversions; MGL treats it as a raw copy (memcpy-like), matching the SPEC description.
claims.code_excerpt: Native blit / CPU-to-CPU / format-conversion paths copy texel bytes without scaling or blending; format-conversion path notes GL CopyImageSubData does raw memcpy of pixel data.
claims.spec_quote: CopyImageSubData does not perform general-purpose conversions such as scaling, resizing, blending, color-space, or format conversions. It should be considered to operate in a manner similar to a CPU memcpy.

CopyImageSubData does not perform general-purpose conversions such as scaling, resizing, blending, color-space, or format conversions. It should be considered to operate in a manner similar to a CPU memcpy. CopyImageSubData can copy between images with different internal formats, provided the formats are compatible. CopyImageSubData also allows copying between certain types of compressed and uncompressed internal formats as described in table 18.4.
